info.title: Infrastructure Intelligence Control Plane API
info.description: Executable control-plane API for authenticated session and runtime identity, collection ingestion, freshness telemetry, backend-neutral evidence and retention observation, resource queries, synchronous or durably queued investigation assessment, governed actions, and bounded plugin sessions and invocation lifecycles. OTLP intake has a separate process and OpenAPI document.

200.description: Process and required durable dependencies are ready

503.description: A required dependency or schema migration is unavailable

get.description: Discover the deployment's non-secret console authentication mode and optional OIDC Authorization Code plus S256 PKCE public-client profile. This endpoint never returns credentials, verifier settings, claim mappings, or client secrets.
Return the non-secret tenant, actor, and role context derived from the authenticated control-plane credential.

Return tenant-contextual, non-secret application, contract, required storage migration, build, and deployment identity for the answering process. Optional revision, chart, and digest fields are omitted when not verifiably supplied.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: The v1alpha1 query supports exactly one hop.

200.description: Point-in-time tenant/source ingestion freshness and delivery-objective evaluation

404.description: No committed source checkpoint exists in the authenticated tenant

get.description: Return process-local metric and trace export outcomes to an authenticated platform administrator. The report contains no endpoint, credential, tenant telemetry, payload, provider response, or exception text and does not affect readiness.

503.description: The process-local exporter health reader returned inconsistent state

get.summary: Read recent deployment-wide telemetry exporter delivery health

200.description: Bounded API and workflow-worker telemetry delivery state

403.description: Platform administrator role or policy approval required

503.description: Shared telemetry health state is unavailable or inconsistent

get.description: Return a deployment-wide rolling OTLP export-attempt objective calculated from bounded pseudonymous samples. The operation is administrator and policy protected and exposes no tenant telemetry, workload identity, exporter configuration, credentials, or provider details.

200.description: Sampled metrics and traces export reliability

503.description: Telemetry export samples are unavailable or inconsistent

get.description: Return a deployment-wide multi-window error-budget burn rate calculated from the same bounded pseudonymous samples as the export SLO report. The operation is administrator and policy protected and exposes no tenant telemetry, workload identity, exporter configuration, credentials, or provider details.

200.description: Sampled metrics and traces export burn rate

503.description: Telemetry export samples are unavailable or inconsistent

get.description: Return the customer OpenTelemetry Collector's own observed sending-queue depth and send-loss objective for its pipeline to IIP's receiver, sourced from the Collector's self-metrics through the customer's configured telemetry backend. Distinct from the export-burn-rate and export-SLO reports, which measure IIP's own outbound exporter attempts. The operation is administrator and policy protected and exposes no tenant telemetry, credentials, or provider details beyond the configured integration and exporter identifiers.

200.description: Collector-observed sending-queue depth and send-loss objective

503.description: The configured telemetry backend is unavailable, or returned an ambiguous or invalid result

get.description: Return exact-tenant transactional-outbox backlog and value-minimized quarantine state to an authenticated platform administrator. The report contains no event data, credentials, destination details, provider responses, or exception text.

200.description: Tenant-scoped backlog and bounded newest-first quarantine state

503.description: The event delivery state is unavailable or inconsistent

get.description: Return the deployment-configured rolling publication-path objective for the authenticated tenant. Each durable outbox row is counted once after its latency deadline; the report contains aggregate counts only and is transport-neutral.

503.description: The delivery objective state is unavailable or inconsistent

get.description: Return the deployment-configured rolling useful-completion objective for durable asynchronous investigations in the authenticated tenant. Each accepted job is counted once after its completion deadline; aggregate failures, cancellations, late completions, and unfinished jobs remain explicit misses.

503.description: The investigation completion objective state is unavailable or inconsistent

get.description: Observe deployment-owned Evidence artifact retention policy and aggregate lifecycle state for the authenticated tenant. This endpoint never mutates storage or returns evidence identities, content, source details, or credentials.

503.description: Evidence retention storage state is unavailable, corrupt, or inconsistent

202.description: Validated observations and any complete-snapshot tombstones are durable; reconciliation membership, aggregate checkpoint, and opaque provider cursor state are committed

201.description: Immutable Evidence envelope referencing the normalized metric result artifact

503.description: The telemetry provider, evidence processor, or store is unavailable

post.description: Collect bounded normalized log evidence for authenticated tenant-scoped resources. The request uses logical services, severities, and attribute filters; provider endpoints, credentials, and vendor query languages remain protected adapter configuration.

201.description: Immutable Evidence envelope referencing the normalized log result artifact

503.description: The log provider, evidence processor, or store is unavailable

post.description: Collect bounded normalized Kubernetes Event evidence for authenticated tenant-scoped resources. Provider endpoint, TLS, namespace/type allowlists, and credentials are protected integration configuration and never request fields; the default backend returns honest no-data unless the read-only Kubernetes API adapter is selected.

201.description: Immutable Evidence envelope referencing the normalized Kubernetes Event result artifact

503.description: The Kubernetes Event provider, evidence processor, or store is unavailable

post.description: Collect bounded value-minimized changes from accepted immutable observations for authenticated tenant-scoped resources.

201.description: Immutable Evidence envelope referencing normalized resource-change history

503.description: The history provider, evidence processor, or store is unavailable

post.description: Collect bounded redacted excerpts from tenant-scoped repository and runbook files explicitly allowlisted in protected integration configuration. Returned text is always marked untrusted data and never grants instructions or authority.

201.description: Immutable Evidence envelope referencing normalized repository/runbook context

503.description: The context provider, evidence processor, or store is unavailable

post.description: Run a bounded investigation. Optional Kubernetes Event, repository/runbook context, resource-change, metric, and historical log selections inherit authenticated identity, resource/time scope, and investigation tool/evidence budgets before using configured backend-neutral adapters. Empty signal lists may be filled from a protected tenant profile and frozen with server-owned digest provenance; clients must not supply catalogSnapshot. Root-cause-scoped selections assess only committed normalized artifacts and record supporting, contradicting, neutral, no-data, or incomplete results. Context and log prose is untrusted data, is never interpreted as instructions, and is not copied into reports.

Validate and durably queue one immutable investigation request within the authenticated tenant's deployment-configured outstanding-job limit. Exact idempotent resubmission remains available when the limit is full. Protected tenant catalog candidates are resolved and content-digested before persistence, then a tenant-scoped worker verifies the frozen snapshot and claims it under a renewable dispatch lease. Investigation upper bounds, budgets, and the separate non-renewable execution deadline remain authoritative.

202.description: Request durably queued or its existing idempotent job returned

get.description: Return bounded dispatch state from the authenticated tenant. Worker identity, claim tokens, request content, evidence, and provider details are never exposed.

post.description: Cancel queued work without execution, or durably propagate cooperative cancellation to a claimed investigation. The first cancellation intent remains immutable.

202.description: Cancellation intent or existing terminal state

get.description: Return the current tenant-scoped lifecycle state. Running state is persisted before tools execute; terminal status points to the immutable report.

post.description: Atomically record the first authenticated cooperative cancellation request. Already committed evidence is retained; no lifecycle or audit data is deleted.

202.description: Cancellation recorded or current terminal status returned

get.description: List newest governed action workflows from one tenant-consistent read model. Each item reconstructs its immutable proposal and any approval, one-shot execution lifecycle, and terminal result.

post.description: Create an immutable proposal bound to a completed investigation and exact target digest. Kubernetes restart parameters bind provider identity; event-delivery replay parameters bind one terminal quarantine generation and require platform-admin proposal authority.

Atomically claim the approved action once, then invoke the configured executor. The safe default is non-mutating; the opt-in Kubernetes executor performs server-side dry-run before any explicitly enabled live restart and records verification or rollback.

200.description: Proposal, one-shot execution lifecycle, or terminal result

get.description: Get one tenant-scoped action read model reconstructed from a consistent proposal, approval, execution, and result snapshot.
Read one durable invocation claim, cancellation intent, or terminal result reference in the authenticated tenant scope.

post.description: Record an auditable cancellation intent. The isolated runner polls the durable intent and returns a terminal cancelled result without granting the plugin control-plane authority.

202.description: Cancellation intent recorded or existing terminal status returned

post.description: Allow a policy-approved platform administrator to close an ambiguous post-deadline claim as outcome unknown without replaying plugin work.

200.description: Terminal reconciled status or an existing terminal status

bearerAuth.description: Bearer credential verified by the configured authenticator. Tenant, actor, and roles are derived from the verified identity and are never accepted from identity assertion headers.

Unauthorized.description: A valid Bearer credential is required

ResourceNotFound.description: The resource is not visible in the tenant scope

StorageUnavailable.description: The authoritative store is temporarily unavailable

InvestigationQueueFull.description: The authenticated tenant has reached its outstanding investigation-job limit

PluginInvocationLifecycleConflict.description: The invocation deadline is still live or stored lifecycle state cannot be reconciled safely

ObservationConflict.description: Observation is stale or conflicts with the current source stream
